# CLI environment

Home-manager base module shared by every host.
Shell: `zsh` (oh-my-zsh, autosuggestions, syntax highlighting) · Prompt: `starship` · Theme: catppuccin (macchiato)

## Shell aliases

| Alias | Command |
| --- | --- |
| `c` | `code .` |
| `devv` | `` nix develop -c zellij -s `basename $PWD` options --default-shell zsh `` |
| `k` | `kubectl` |
| `lg` | `lazygit` |
| `s` | `ssh` |
| `ur` | `uv run` |

## Shell functions

Defined in `programs.zsh.initContent`: `pasteinit`, `pastefinish`, `run`, `shell`

oh-my-zsh plugins: `git`, `gh`, `composer`, `rsync`, `aws`

## Programs (home-manager managed)

- `alacritty`
- `broot`
- `difftastic`
- `fzf`
- `git`
- `home-manager`
- `k9s`
- `lazygit`
- `lsd`
- `starship`
- `tmux`
- `zellij`
- `zoxide`
- `zsh`

### tmux

Prefix: `C-n` · Mouse: `true` · Plugins: `pain-control`

### Alacritty

Font: `MesloLGSDZ Nerd Font` (size 18)

### Theming

Catppuccin integrations: `fzf`, `k9s`, `zellij`

## Packages

`agenix`, [`alejandra`](https://github.com/kamadorueda/alejandra), [`argocd`](https://argo-cd.readthedocs.io/en/stable/), [`asciinema`](https://asciinema.org/), [`awscli2`](https://aws.amazon.com/cli/), [`bat`](https://github.com/sharkdp/bat), [`bind`](https://www.isc.org/bind/), [`bottom`](https://github.com/ClementTsang/bottom), [`bun`](https://bun.sh), [`cheat`](https://github.com/cheat/cheat), [`cmctl`](https://cert-manager.io/), [`duf`](https://github.com/muesli/duf/), [`fd`](https://github.com/sharkdp/fd), [`ffmpeg`](https://www.ffmpeg.org/), [`file`](https://darwinsys.com/file), [`fx`](https://github.com/antonmedv/fx), [`gh`](https://cli.github.com/), [`gnumake`](https://www.gnu.org/software/make/), [`htop`](https://htop.dev), [`httpie`](https://httpie.org/), [`iftop`](http://ex-parrot.com/pdw/iftop/), [`iperf`](https://software.es.net/iperf/), [`jq`](https://jqlang.github.io/jq/), [`kubectl`](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubectl), [`kubernetes-helm`](https://github.com/helm/helm), [`kubeseal`](https://github.com/bitnami/sealed-secrets), [`lazydocker`](https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazydocker), [`nil`](https://github.com/oxalica/nil), [`nix-tree`](https://hackage.haskell.org/package/nix-tree), [`nixd`](https://github.com/nix-community/nixd), [`nixfmt`](https://github.com/NixOS/nixfmt), [`nixpkgs-fmt`](https://nix-community.github.io/nixpkgs-fmt), [`nnn`](https://github.com/jarun/nnn), [`nodejs`](https://nodejs.org), [`ookla-speedtest`](https://www.speedtest.net/apps/cli), [`opentofu`](https://opentofu.org/), [`ranger`](https://ranger.fm/), [`rename`](https://github.com/pstray/rename), [`ripgrep`](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep), [`ruff`](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff), [`sshfs-fuse`](https://github.com/libfuse/sshfs), [`tabview`](https://github.com/TabViewer/tabview), [`unzip`](http://www.info-zip.org), [`uv`](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv), [`wget`](https://www.gnu.org/software/wget/), [`yt-dlp`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/)

On NixOS, `programs.nix-ld` is on so `uv` can run the
python-build-standalone interpreters it downloads — they ask for
`/lib/ld-linux-*.so`, which nixos otherwise doesn't provide.
